Your first claim or counterclaim locks your claimed role for this run. Dead players are grey.

TOWN — Sheriff
Ability: Investigate one other player each night; learn their apparent faction.
Limits: Forged evidence can change the result.
Claims: Claim your own role and report your findings.
Goal: Help Town eliminate the Mafia and Serial Killer.

TOWN — Physician
Ability: Protect one other player each night.
Limits: Basic protection stops basic attacks, but not a powerful Serial Killer attack. A protection notice does not prove an attack happened.
Claims: Claim your own role and report your protection.
Goal: Help Town eliminate the Mafia and Serial Killer.

TOWN — Villager
Ability: Use discussion and votes; you have no night action.
Limits: You cannot claim an acting role.
Claims: No role claim or night report.
Goal: Help Town eliminate the Mafia and Serial Killer.

TOWN — Vigilante
Ability: Shoot one other player at night with a basic attack.
Limits: Two bullets. Passing or being blocked preserves a bullet. If your shot kills Town, you cannot shoot again and die from guilt at the end of the following night. Protection and blocking cannot stop guilt.
Claims: Claim your own role and report your action.
Goal: Help Town eliminate the Mafia and Serial Killer.

TOWN — Lookout
Ability: Watch one other player each night; learn who visited them.
Limits: You learn identities, not abilities or the watched player's outgoing target.
Claims: Claim your own role and report visitors.
Goal: Help Town eliminate the Mafia and Serial Killer.

MAFIA — Mafioso
Ability: Carry out the Mafia's shared basic night attack.
Limits: One team kill each night. You know your teammates and cannot attack them. A living player Mafioso chooses the team target or pass. If the last Mafioso dies, one surviving Mafia member inherits the role.
Claims: Bluff a Town role and give fabricated reports.
Goal: Secure a Mafia victory.

MAFIA — Strongarm
Ability: Block one other player's night action.
Limits: Blocks resolve simultaneously; a blocked Strongarm still carries out its accepted block. You know your teammates and their recorded night actions. You may inherit Mafioso when the team loses its killer.
Claims: Bluff a Town role and give fabricated reports.
Goal: Secure a Mafia victory.

MAFIA — Forger
Ability: Forge evidence against one other player each night.
Limits: The target appears Mafia to investigations for that night only. You know your teammates and their recorded night actions. You may inherit Mafioso when the team loses its killer.
Claims: Bluff a Town role and give fabricated reports.
Goal: Secure a Mafia victory.

NEUTRAL — Serial Killer
Ability: Attack one other player each night with a powerful attack.
Limits: Basic innate defense stops basic attacks. You do not know Mafia teammates. A lone Serial Killer and night-immune Ego form a stalemate.
Claims: Bluff a Town role and give fabricated reports.
Goal: Outlast Town and the Mafia.

NEUTRAL — Ego
Ability: Stay alive; you have no active night ability.
Limits: Immune to night attacks, but vulnerable to execution. Investigations read Town.
Claims: Bluff a Town role and give fabricated reports.
Goal: Survive until a normal Mafia win, then steal it. A Town win is your loss.

NEUTRAL — Jester
Ability: Get yourself executed by the day vote.
Limits: A night death does not count. After execution, choose one living Town member to kill before night. No eligible voter means no revenge kill.
Claims: Bluff a Town role and give fabricated reports.
Goal: Be executed; revenge does not change your earned win.
